title: Upgrade labeling consensus to Dawid-Skene / EM estimator
context: A future-backlog upgrade to the labeling consensus, moving from weighted-majority (v1) to a Dawid-Skene / EM estimator once annotation volume supports it. It must remain sparsity-aware given citizen-science cold-start conditions and preserve deterministic, provenance-carrying behavior. Builds on csp-label-012.
objective: Upgrade the @csp/label consensus from weighted-majority to a sparsity-aware Dawid-Skene / EM estimator, preserving determinism and label provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements a Dawid-Skene / EM consensus estimator that is sparsity-aware for cold-start annotation volume
Falls back gracefully to weighted-majority when data is too sparse
Deterministic (seeded) and reproducible; label provenance preserved
Evaluated against calibration items; tested on synthetic data
output: A PR upgrading @csp/label consensus to a Dawid-Skene / EM estimator.
